name: ktc-production-control-desktop
description: KTC Production Control Desktop - A+B theo tháng, báo cáo theo công đoạn, pending chạy lại từ dữ liệu DB mới nhất
author: KTC

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../frontend run build && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.dist:win: npm run preflight && npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64
scripts.dist:portable: npm run preflight && npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run preflight && npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/platformPaths.cjs && node --check scripts/preflight.cjs && node --check scripts/checkPlatformPaths.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/desktopLog.cjs && node --check electron/excelPaths.cjs && node --check electron/authToken.cjs && node --check electron/companyExcelLocal.cjs && node --check electron/productionCalculationEngine.cjs && node --check electron/excelDualLayout.cjs && node --check electron/monthlyWorkbookLocal.cjs && node --check scripts/smokeExcel.cjs && npm run check:excel-db-sync && npm run check:platform-paths && node --check scripts/fieldReadiness.cjs && node scripts/fieldReadiness.cjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run preflight && npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run preflight && npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
